fetch-sql-table-and-run-pipeline

Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const t0 = Date.now();
await page.getByRole("button", { name: "⇩ Fetch table & run pipeline" }).click();
let loaded = false, elapsed = 0, status = "";
for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  status = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const el = document.getElementById('fileInfo') || document.querySelector('.fileinfo');
    const txt = el ? (el.innerText||'').trim() : '';
    const flagged = document.querySelectorAll('#flaggedList > *, .flag-card, .flagcard').length;
    return JSON.stringify({ fileInfo: txt, flagged });
  });
  const s = JSON.parse(status);
  if (s.fileInfo && !/No file loaded/i.test(s.fileInfo) && !/loading|fetch/i.test(s.fileInfo)) { loaded = true; elapsed = Date.now()-t0; break; }
  if (s.flagged > 0) { loaded = true; elapsed = Date.now()-t0; break; }
}
elapsed = elapsed || (Date.now()-t0);
console.log("LOAD_MS:", elapsed);
console.log("STATUS:", status);
const detail = await page.evaluate(() => {
  const body = document.body.innerText;
  const m = body.match(/[\d,]{3,}\s*rows?/gi) || [];
  return { rowMentions: m.slice(0,10), fileInfo: (document.getElementById('fileInfo')||{}).innerText || null };
});
console.log("DETAIL:", JSON.stringify(detail));
console.log(loaded ? "PASS load" : "FAIL load");

select-groq-model

2 actions · 30.2s
Script
const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.locator("#q0").click();
await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
let opts = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
  opts = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const s = document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel');
    if (!s) return null;
    return [...s.options].map(o => ({ v: o.value, t: o.textContent, sel: o.selected }));
  });
  if (opts && opts.length) break;
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
}
console.log("PICKER_OPTIONS:", JSON.stringify(opts, null, 1));
if (!opts || !opts.length) { console.log("FAIL model-picker-empty"); }
else {
  const groq = opts.find(o => /Groq/i.test(o.t));
  if (!groq) console.log("FAIL no-groq-option");
  else {
    await page.locator("select.rca-model-sel").selectOption(groq.v);
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    const cur = await page.evaluate(() => ({ sel: document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel').selectedOptions[0].textContent, model: window.RCA_MODEL }));
    console.log("SELECTED:", JSON.stringify(cur));
    console.log(/groq/i.test(JSON.stringify(cur)) ? "PASS groq-selected" : "FAIL groq-not-selected");
  }
}

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
await page.keyboard && await page.press("body", "Escape").catch(()=>{});
await page.evaluate(() => {
  document.querySelectorAll('.fdrop, .fmenu, .open').forEach(e => e.classList.remove('open'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.fpanel').forEach(e => { e.style.display='none'; });
});
await page.waitForTimeout(500);
const before = await page.evaluate(() => ({ open: document.querySelectorAll('.fdrop.open, .open').length }));
console.log("AFTER_CLOSE:", JSON.stringify(before));
try {
  await page.locator("#q0").click({ timeout: 8000 });
  console.log("clicked q0 natively");
} catch (e) {
  console.log("WARN native click blocked:", e.message.split("\n")[0]);
  await page.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('q0').click());
  console.log("clicked q0 via dom .click()");
}
await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
let opts = null;
for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
  opts = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const s = document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel');
    return s ? [...s.options].map(o => ({ v: o.value, t: o.textContent, sel: o.selected })) : null;
  });
  if (opts && opts.length) break;
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
}
console.log("PICKER_OPTIONS:", JSON.stringify(opts, null, 1));
if (!opts || !opts.length) console.log("FAIL model-picker-empty");
else {
  const groq = opts.find(o => /Groq/i.test(o.t));
  if (!groq) console.log("FAIL no-groq-option");
  else {
    await page.locator("select.rca-model-sel").selectOption(groq.v);
    await page.waitForTimeout(800);
    const cur = await page.evaluate(() => ({ sel: document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel').selectedOptions[0].textContent, model: window.RCA_MODEL }));
    console.log("SELECTED:", JSON.stringify(cur));
    console.log(/groq/i.test(JSON.stringify(cur)) ? "PASS groq-selected" : "FAIL groq-not-selected");
  }
}
const hdr = await page.evaluate(() => (document.querySelector('.rtitle')||{}).innerText || null);
console.log("REPORT_TITLE:", hdr);

const page = await browser.getPage("main");
const t0 = Date.now();
await page.evaluate(() => {
  const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('#investigationPanel button')].find(x => /Investigate Root Cause/i.test(x.innerText));
  if (b) b.click(); else throw new Error("no investigate button");
});
let done = false, ms = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
  const s = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const p = document.getElementById('investigationPanel');
    const t = p ? p.innerText : '';
    return { len: t.length, hasEngine: /engine/i.test(t), hasRoot: /root cause/i.test(t), busy: /investigating|running|thinking/i.test(t), head: t.slice(0,200) };
  });
  if (s.hasEngine || (s.hasRoot && !s.busy)) { done = true; ms = Date.now()-t0; break; }
  if (i % 3 === 0) console.log("poll", i, JSON.stringify(s));
}
ms = ms || (Date.now()-t0);
console.log("RCA_MS:", ms, "DONE:", done);

  const s = document.querySelector('select.rca-model-sel');

  const i = [...s.options].findIndex(o => /Groq/i.test(o.textContent));

  return { chosen: s.selectedOptions[0].textContent };
});

});
let done=false;
for (let i=0;i<30;i++){
